answer: A verifier tends an orchard of five vouched identities, staking on a trellis that climbs $200 a rung, so the fifth locks $1,000 and a full orchard ties up $3,000. New identities sit thirty days in an open meadow, open to any established agent's challenge. Three checkers retest a challenged identity within a week, on device key and work history. One fake burns the verifier's whole $3,000 orchard at once. Bribing twenty verifiers at $2,500 each plants one hundred clones for $50,000; one honest agent costs $0, real ones never trip the burn. A vineyard loses the whole row to one rotten vine.
